verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's first-party docs state that the same inference cloud hosts LLMs alongside vision, image generation, video generation and speech models. They specifically name Vision & OCR multimodal models, FLUX and Stable Diffusion for image generation, text-to-video, Whisper speech recognition and text-to-speech. The evidence is limited to overview-level catalog claims, not API-level detail on how to invoke each modality. Missing for 10: endpoint or request documentation for vision, audio and image-generation calls (for example whether they work through the OpenAI-compatible API), and independent or hands-on corroboration that these non-text models work.
